name: The Wrong Gate

passive_description.localized: Increases ATK. When the wearer performs healing, increases the wearer's Anima DMG and all allies' DMG for 20s. Same-name effects do not stack.

tested_hypotheses: An actual Edgar Ultimate or Iroi ordinary Skill healing callback by the living equipped wearer triggers after settlement when the recipient is living and once-rounded pre-cap healing is positive; full-HP overheal qualifies. Iroi's producer is bounded by the owning iroi.skill_team_heal_v1 model, whose frozen tip says the ordinary Skill heals the whole team once and whose effect curve supplies the admitted-coordinate ratio.
One shared-name reset effect applies wearer Anima (NATURE) DMG and general DMG to every other living configured teammate; the wearer is excluded from the ally grant.
A later callback refreshes all shared-name recipient instances at callback world time; effects use half-open expiry and the latest triggering source, with Snapshot persistence after source death.
Off-field Edgar and Iroi callbacks remain eligible; dead recipients, non-healing actions, and zero pre-cap healing do not trigger.

independent_oracles.source: Native synthetic NATURE packet: 1000 ATK becomes 1160; 30% Anima yields 1508 until expiry. Native Mint Skill: 1000 x .9 x 1.1 = 990, after allied 15%: 1000 x .9 x 1.25 = 1125. Public T1-T5 Edgar Burst uses (.projected_atk + base_atk x passive) x 6.855 x .5 x Cosmos/general zone; Mint Normal packets use .178/.396 x projected ATK x .5 x additive Anima/general zone.

known_gaps: The owner Anima bonus is verified by typed synthetic NATURE packet selection, not by an Edgar native Anima action; the public rotation establishes the ally general-DMG behavior.
